name: Iron Company
source:
At the climax of a desperate war for farmland, John Sykes and Petra Raskoph fought a duel to the death. Dragged away to safety by their comrades, both of them survived. 

A year after the end of the war, they meet again by chance; Sykes, directionless, depressed, and running low on cash, and Raskoph with a dangerous but lucrative job offer that neither of them can afford to turn down.

[From [url=https://doodlemancy.itch.io/iron-company]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在争夺农田的绝望战争达到高潮时，约翰·赛克斯和佩特拉·拉斯科夫进行了一场殊死的决斗。被战友拖到安全地带，两人都活了下来。

战争结束一年后，他们在一次偶然的机会下再次相遇。赛克斯没有方向，心情郁闷，现金也所剩无几，而拉斯科夫则提供了一份危险但利润丰厚的工作机会，他们谁都无法拒绝。

[来自[url=https://doodlemancy.itch.io/iron-company]Itch.io[/url]]
